missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/idle connections, max_connections, wait events
Order service pool configuration and pool wait/acquire metrics
Postgres logs showing connection limit or timeout errors
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool size 5 and idle 0, but no Postgres-side metrics confirm exhaustion versus slow queries or DB unavailability.

report.explanation: All four checkout requests return 502 after ~2s. Traces show inventory and payment succeed, but postgres.save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable (pool size 5, idle 0) and order calls hit ReadTimeout, propagating 503/502 to the gateway. This bounds the fault to the order-to-postgres path, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion; Postgres-side metrics are still needed to confirm.
